hints: Find first term $a = u_1 = -6$ and common difference $d = u_2 - u_1 = -4.5 - (-6) = 1.5$.
walkthrough:
Evaluate the first two terms of the arithmetic progression from $u_n = \frac{1}{2}(3n - 15)$:
$$u_1 = a = \frac{1}{2}(3(1) - 15) = \frac{-12}{2} = -6$$
$$u_2 = \frac{1}{2}(3(2) - 15) = \frac{-9}{2} = -4.5$$
$$d = u_2 - u_1 = -4.5 - (-6) = 1.5 = \frac{3}{2}$$

Multiply across by $2$ and form standard quadratic form:
$$3n^2 - 27n - 336 = 0 \implies n^2 - 9n - 112 = 0$$

Factorise and solve for the positive integer $n$:
$$(n - 16)(n + 7) = 0 \implies n = 16 \quad (\text{rejecting } n = -7)$$
